proof:
Source: parent proof step (2b), stated for a general bounded Lipschitz kernel supported in the unit ball.

1. (Support.) We have s ≥ 2ε > 0. Let x ∈ K and y ∉ B. Then ‖x − y‖ ≥ ‖y‖ − ‖x‖ ≥ 1 − (1 − s) = s ≥ ε, so ‖ε⁻¹(x − y)‖ ≥ 1 and ρ(ε⁻¹(x − y)) = 0 (norm_sub_norm_le, one_le_inv_mul₀).

2. (Integrability.)
- u and |u| are integrable on B: u is continuous on the compact closedBall(0, 1) (ContinuousOn.integrableOn_compact, then IntegrableOn.mono_set with ball_subset_closedBall).
- For each x, y ↦ u(y)ρ(ε⁻¹(x − y)) is continuous and dominated by C|u(y)|, hence integrable on B (Integrable.mono').

3. (Change of variables.) We show that for x ∈ K: v(x) = ε^{−n}∫_B u(y)ρ(ε⁻¹(x − y)) dy.
- With f(w) := u(x − w)ρ(ε⁻¹w) we have u(x − εz)ρ(z) = f(εz) (inv_smul_smul₀).
- So ∫ f(εz) dz = |ε^{−n}|∫ f(w) dw (Measure.integral_comp_smul, finrank_euclideanSpace_fin).
- ∫ u(x − w)ρ(ε⁻¹w) dw = ∫ u(y)ρ(ε⁻¹(x − y)) dy (integral_sub_left_eq_self).
- By step 1 the last integrand vanishes off B (setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero).

4. (i) |v(x)| ≤ ε^{−n}∫_B |u(y)||ρ(ε⁻¹(x − y))| dy ≤ ε^{−n}∫_B |u(y)|C dy = ε^{−n}C∫_B|u| (abs_integral_le_integral_abs, integral_mono_of_nonneg, integral_mul_const).

5. (ii) For x, x' ∈ K, step 3 and integral_sub give
v(x) − v(x') = ε^{−n}∫_B u(y)[ρ(ε⁻¹(x − y)) − ρ(ε⁻¹(x' − y))] dy.
Moreover |ρ(ε⁻¹(x − y)) − ρ(ε⁻¹(x' − y))| ≤ C‖ε⁻¹(x − y) − ε⁻¹(x' − y)‖ = Cε⁻¹‖x − x'‖. Hence
|v(x) − v(x')| ≤ ε^{−n}·Cε⁻¹‖x − x'‖∫_B|u| = (ε^{n+1})⁻¹C‖x − x'‖∫_B|u| (pow_succ, mul_inv). ∎
